theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.SeminormalRep.trace_heckeIncl_mul_lastGen {μ : YoungDiagram} {K : Type u_1} [Field K] {q : K} (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity q) (m : ℕ) (hN : μ.cells.card = m + 2) (y : Hecke K q q⁻¹ m) :
((seminormalRep q hq0 hq2 (m + 1) hN) ((HeckeInclusion.heckeIncl K q q⁻¹ m) y) * genMat q (m + 1) ⋯ ⋯).trace = ∑ T : Mathlib.StandardYoungTableau μ, (seminormalRep q hq0 hq2 (m + 1) hN) ((HeckeInclusion.heckeIncl K q q⁻¹ m) y) T T * Seminormal.seminormalParam q (TableauCells.axialDist T (m + 1))

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.SeminormalRep.seminormalRep_heckeIncl_mem_blockSubalgebra {μ : YoungDiagram} {K : Type u_1} [Field K] {q : K} (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : GenericParameter.NotRootOfUnity q) (m : ℕ) (hN : μ.cells.card = m + 2) (y : Hecke K q q⁻¹ m) :
(seminormalRep q hq0 hq2 (m + 1) hN) ((HeckeInclusion.heckeIncl K q q⁻¹ m) y) ∈ blockSubalgebra (m + 2)

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.SeminormalRep.trace_mul_genMat_of_adjoin {μ : YoungDiagram} {K : Type u_1} [Field K] (q : K) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkn : k + 1 ≤ μ.cells.card) {X : Matrix (Mathlib.StandardYoungTableau μ) (Mathlib.StandardYoungTableau μ) K} (hX : X ∈ Algebra.adjoin K (earlyGens q (k + 1))) :
(X * genMat q k hk hkn).trace = ∑ T : Mathlib.StandardYoungTableau μ, X T T * Seminormal.seminormalParam q (TableauCells.axialDist T k)
